description: HELD-OUT set: labeled before agent-drift ever ran on these repos. Same schema as labeled-findings.json; not_stale entries with trap 'verified_true' are claims checked and found true.

stale.evidence: No vale script; only valelint and vale:fix.
API is RPC-style POST endpoints (server/routes/api/documents/documents.ts documents.info); file line 1 itself says RPC.

stale.claim: Database adapters use Drizzle under the hood
stale.evidence: db-mongodb uses mongoose 9.9.2; only SQL adapters use drizzle.
No CLI parses --no-auto-login (disableAutoLogin is only a config option); buildConfigWithDefaults.ts:182 disables only when the env var === "true", so =false leaves it on.
test/dbAdapters.ts uses docker-hosted mongodb (replicaSet rs0); no memory server.
richtext-lexical package.json has no translateNewKeys script.

stale.claim: pnpm run lint runs all linters including stylelint
stale.evidence: lint = turbo run lint -> packages run eslint only; stylelint only in root lint:css.

stale.claim: Generate investigation prompt from crash: script/crash-to-prompt <issue-id>
stale.evidence: No script/crash-to-prompt in the repo (script/sentry-fetch exists); the only reference is .rules:166.
